title: Estimation of Strawberry Canopy Volume in Unmanned Aerial Vehicle RGB Imagery Using an Object Detection-Based Convolutional Neural Network.
summary: An object-detection/CNN workflow estimated strawberry canopy volume from UAV RGB imagery against measured plant-volume references in a field experiment.
ai_technology: a 2023–24 strawberry field and measured-volume reference; Results compare CNN and geometric estimates on held-out images.
